Structural (long-term) liquidity risk ma:
• Ensure a structurally sound
balance sheet.
• Identify and manage
structural liquidity
mismatches.
• Determine and apply
behavioral profiling.
• Manage long-term cash
flows.
• Preserve a diversified
funding base.
• Inform term funding
requirements.
• Assess foreign currency
liquidity exposures.
• Establish liquidity risk

metrics
